text:
yasmin: SI is blocked during a Private deploy at a regulated customer. Two problems: marketplace image validation fails inside their air-gapped appliance, and our runtime can't complete KMS attestation to their HSM. Need quick architecture review + escalation plan.
diego: Brief symptoms? checksum mismatch or handshake error?
yasmin: Marketplace pull fails with 412 checksum mismatch; HSM attestation shows 503 from validation service intermittently.
frieder: For marketplace: their appliance only accepts .tar bundles with a manifest + detached signature, and it refuses compressed layers we currently ship. Could repackage, but need partnership sign-off for marketplace consumer formats.
si-lead: HSM issue: their HSM only allows mTLS from whitelisted client certs. Our control-plane uses ephemeral cert rotation; the customer's security team requires a static client cert for attestation calls.
diego: Two-track: 1) Marketplace packaging: produce an appliance bundle (tar + manifest + detached sig) and deliver via their internal repo; 2) HSM: propose a gateway that terminates mTLS with static cert on their side and proxies to our ephemeral cert endpoint. That gateway can be managed by SI or customer.
yasmin: Customer prefers no long-lived certs on our side. Gateway model sounds acceptable. ACTION: @frieder start a marketplace bundle patch and include checksum algorithm note. @si-lead draft gateway architecture + security controls.
market-bot: Release candidate 2026-02-market-bundle-1 created for review. Link: https://internal.redwood/mkt/2026-02-bundle-1
frieder: Packaging note: use sha512 manifest and include uncompressed blob hash to match appliance verifier. Will add to bundle and push candidate to private S3.
si-lead: For gateway, recommend 1) static client cert installed in customer's HSM trust store 2) gateway validates attestation and forwards to Redwood control-plane over TLS with our ephemeral cert 3) gateway logs handed to SI for audit. Need SOW addendum for gateway build + 8 hours on-site if needed.
diego: Also surface this to partner-eng: if the appliance vendor needs a signature format change, we may need to coordinate with hardware partner for a signed manifest spec.
yasmin: Escalation path: if packaging + gateway not OK in 24h, bring in partner-eng + security-eng and prep SOW. @market-bot tag partner-eng.
market-bot: Tagging partner-eng per request.
si-lead: SI will attempt a temporary workaround: run a local verifier in their staging that tolerates gzip layer differences to unblock validation while bundle is prepared.
yasmin: Good. Keep thread as canonical record. Please paste final bundle artifact link and gateway design here when ready.
diego: I'll draft the gateway diagram and checklist (cert lifecycle, audit logging, allowed ciphers) and drop in 3h.
si-lead: Noted. Will also capture times for onsite pricing if needed.
yasmin: Thanks team. Logging incident: PVT-9488 "SI: Marketplace/HSM blockers for Private deploy at regulated customer". Will update customer after bundle pilot. :white_check_mark:
